replacement.sketch: No observability change required: named cases explain declared-field diagnostic identity and explicitly retain opaque cause exclusion. No cause is swallowed by a runner and no asynchronous operation occurs.

No observability change required: redacted error messages, lengths and exact encoded key sets are asserted explicitly; native properties retain adapter failure formatting. Do not log generated environment payloads or reinterpret synthetic data as secret material.

The CLI result-union property throws expect inside manual native checkEffect before returning true. Although its outer matcher retains the whole result object, callback throws still bypass adapter normalizeProperty. Preserve both union equivalences and fcRuns(50) through a registered property so failures retain shrink/replay context; keep redacted CLI diagnostics unchanged.

No observability change required: native property registration provides normalization and counterexample formatting; named boundary cases identify failures. Secret references remain unresolved, and adding logs of generated secret-related payloads is not proposed.

No observability-specific change required: probe failures expose a redacted step and category, and the existing wrong-skill/missing-model cases assert the step. Additional branch controls belong to the property row; raw HTTP/provider payload logging is not proposed.

No observability change required: golden mismatches retain exact JSON/hash comparisons; placeholder failures retain reason/surface, and native properties preserve generated context. No unnecessary logging of rendered configuration is proposed.

No observability change required: error cases assert executable/subcommand/exit/diagnostic absence and stderr length, and names distinguish the operations. The shared-recorder risk is tracked in resource/flake, not duplicated as a logging request.

No observability change required: the support module has no tester wrapper or asynchronous body; consumer tests compare full canonical JSON/hash. It must remain covered as support without inventing runtime test counts.

A stalled acquisition can be npm staging, a Node probe/download or workbench setup, but makeWorkbench records no last completed stage. Add opt-in redacted stage context through the accepted instrumentation seam; preserve the 10-minute hook and 120/240-second body budgets as distinct limits, and keep process finalizers/native I/O. Do not expose environment values, stdout payloads or secret references in new logs.
